reviewerMethod: Codex visual source-by-source review of the 21-page scan using the repository-local chapter-ingestion workflow, followed by manifest, source-hash, schema, reference and rubric-total checks

scope.strategy: Sparse, exercise-led selection: every bank prompt comes from Exercises I-III, but repeated variants are intentionally omitted.
scope.included: Foundational Exercise I questions, a broad but non-repetitive Exercise II set, selected end-of-chapter Exercise III questions, and the case study.
crossedOutExclusions: Exercise II C.2(j), the egg-and-bottle air-pressure activity
Exercise III A.1(v) and other thermal-expansion assessment material
scope.densityExclusions: Repeated assertion-reason, fill-in-the-blank, true/false, matching, odd-one-out, definition and crossword variants were sampled or omitted when the same eligible concept was already assessed directly.
scope.nonExerciseExclusions: Activities, projects, in-text prompts and newly invented variants were not added.

sourceAssetReadiness.notes: All child-facing prompts are self-contained text. The copyrighted PDF remains local-only.

advisory: Handwritten strike-throughs were interpreted conservatively; excluded areas are listed explicitly above.
This is a selective exercise bank, not an exhaustive transcription of every exercise subpart.
